info.name: Sonatype Application Categories API
info.description: Operations tagged Application Categories across 2 of this provider's published API definitions: sonatype-lifecycle-openapi.yml, sonatype-iq-openapi.yml. Each path carries the servers of the definition it was published in.

item.name: Get applicable tags by application public id

variable.description: (Required) Provide the application public ID assigned by IQ Server.

request.description: Grouping applications with similar characteristics into categories makes policy management easier. You can then create a policy that applies to a specific category. Use this method to retrieve a list of application categories that can be applied to applications in this organization.

response.name: Returns all application categories or tags that can be applied to this application,  by providing the application public ID.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

response.name: A list of application categories that can be applied to the specified application. Each application category or tag consists of an id, name, description and color.
